name: linkup-expo-web

scripts.build: npm --prefix mobile ci && npm --prefix mobile run build:web
scripts.test:linky: node --test tests/linky-usage.test.mjs tests/app-review.test.mjs tests/linky-companion.test.mjs tests/linky-shortlist.test.mjs tests/linky-text.test.mjs
scripts.test:firestore: npx --yes firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --project demo-linkup --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/firestore-profile/*.test.cjs"
scripts.test:builder: node --test tests/builder-core.test.mjs tests/contributions.test.mjs tests/build-habit.test.mjs tests/activity-league.test.mjs tests/group-package.test.mjs tests/daily-workbench.test.mjs

description: LINKUP is an Expo React Native app for mobile and web. Production web deploys serve the Expo app from mobile/ via Vercel; the api/ directory holds the Vercel serverless functions (they use firebase-admin and the resvg PNG renderer).
